title: Fourier expansion of the transformed function
statement: Let $p$ be any real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. Write $\widehat p(S)$ for the Fourier coefficient of $p$ at $S$. Then $\displaystyle\frac{1-p((-1)^{x_1},\ldots,(-1)^{x_n})}{2}=\frac{1-\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}\widehat p(S)\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-2)^{|T|}\prod_{i\in T}\mathbf{1}\{x_i=1\}}{2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$x$ is a bit vector of length $n$
